To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the solvatochromism method could be used to determine the second-order polarizability of both low-molecule mass chromophores, and polymer with chromophore moiety attached to the chains, and (b) crosslinked polymer DGEBA functionalized with p-NA exhibits the higher second-order NLO and temporal stability.
the second-order polarizability of the chromophore p-NA and the functionalized polymer DGBEA-p-NA have been determined using a solvato-chromic method.
the second-order NLO response of epoxy polymers doped with p-NA is enhanced by functionalization of the main chain with p-NA.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the synthesis of new materials with high second-order nonlinear optical properties and with the study of the influence of molecular structure of chromophores on the second-order NLO response of the doped polymers.
the synthesis of epoxy polymers doped with p-NA or with p-NA attached to the main chains and the investigation of their second-order NLO response and temporal stability.
the synthesis, characterization and properties of epoxy resins with chromophore p-NA moities in the main chain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the second-order NLO activity and temporal stability of the poled polymers depend on the molecular structure of the chromophore moities and on the chemical structure of the polymer.
the functionalized epoxy polymers DGEBA-pNA are promising candidates for the development of NLO polymers with high second-order polarizability and temporal stability.
the functionalized linear polymer is a better choice for the preparation of poled NLO epoxy polymers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the functionalization of the polymer chains is an important factor to achieve a good temporal stability of the second-order NLO polymers.
it is possible to improve the temporal stability of poled polymers by functionalization of the polymer main chain with chromophore units.
the best NLO properties and stability of poled epoxy polymes could be achieved by the functionalization of epoxy polymers with chromopore moieties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the second-order NLO polymers can be obtained by the use of functionalized monomers in the polymerization process.
the second-order NLO polymer properties are improved by attaching chromophore moeities to the polymer main chains.
the second-order NLO polymer properties are strongly dependent on both the molecular polarizabilities of the chromophore moeities and the polymer chain structure.
